name: Memory Swappiness Tuning
description: Checks kernel memory swappiness tendency. Values >60 cause unnecessary disk paging.
pass_msg: Swappiness is well-balanced for low-latency memory operations.
fail_msg: Swappiness value is non-optimal - System may page aggressively to disk.

name: Storage Space & Disk Pressure
description: Detects if primary storage partition has fallen below safe operational threshold (500 MB).
pass_msg: Ample free storage space available for system operations and caches.
fail_msg: Low disk space alert - Risk of APT/package manager crashes or container lockup.

name: Hardware Thermal Throttling
description: Monitors CPU package temperature to prevent thermal throttling or hardware damage.
pass_msg: Thermal temperatures within safe operational limits.
fail_msg: High CPU temperature detected - Hardware may throttle clock frequency to dissipate heat.
